about.title: Head Basketball Coach
about.bio: A former competitive player turned dedicated coach, I bring years of experience developing guards, forwards, and post players from youth leagues through varsity. My sessions focus on fundamentals, IQ, and the mental edge that separates good from great.

hero.headline: Train Smarter. Play Bigger.
hero.subline: Private basketball coaching — shooting mechanics, ball handling, and game IQ for players who want to level up.

services.title: 1-on-1 Skills Training
services.description: Personalized sessions targeting your position, shot mechanics, handle, and basketball IQ.

services.title: Group Training
services.description: Small-group sessions (2–5 players) — competitive drills, team concepts, and live reps.

services.title: Film & Game Planning
services.description: Review your game film, identify tendencies, and build a strategy for your role on the court.

testimonials.quote: My son went from a bench player to starting point guard in one season. The work on his handle and IQ was game-changing.

testimonials.quote: The shooting mechanics sessions alone changed my game completely. I'm making shots I was missing all last season.

success_stories.name: Darius W.
success_stories.story: Darius had all the natural tools but his shot mechanics were inconsistent under pressure. After a full off-season working on his release and footwork, he became the team's leading scorer.
success_stories.result: Team Leading Scorer · All-Conference Second Team

faq.question: What age groups do you train?
faq.answer: We work with players from 4th grade through college level. Sessions are designed around your current skill set — beginners welcome.

faq.question: Where do sessions take place?
faq.answer: Training takes place at local gyms and courts in the area. The specific location is confirmed when booking.

faq.question: How long are sessions?
faq.answer: 1-on-1 sessions run 60 minutes. Group sessions are 90 minutes. Package options are available for consistent training.

faq.question: What should my player bring?
faq.answer: Basketball shoes, a water bottle, and a personal basketball if you have one. All training equipment is provided.

faq.question: Do you train both male and female players?
faq.answer: Yes — I work with players of all backgrounds. The fundamentals and competitive mindset apply equally.
